en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1202 - Ali ibn Ja'far was asked about his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)

about a woman leading other women in prayer:
"What is the limit of raising her voice in the takbir (saying 'Allahu Akbar') and in recitation?"
Imam (as) replied: "To the extent that they can hear her."
